title: Open CELLIO STATUS Sub-Screen From VISU_MANCONTROL to View Cell Control I/O Values
summary: From the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL, use the CELLIO STATUS button to open the CELLIO STATUS sub-screen and view cell control input/output values per tipper for troubleshooting/verification.
when_to_use: Use when you need to verify cell control input/output values per tipper from the Operator Station HMI by opening the CELLIO STATUS sub-screen via VISU_MANCONTROL.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Navigate the Operator Station HMI (VISU_MANCONTROL) and verify the CELLIO STATUS sub-screen displays cell control input/output values per tipper.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the Operator Station maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL and the CELLIO STATUS sub-screen.

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the CELLIO STATUS button (Item 9).
CELLIO STATUS screen showing cell control input/output values per tipper.

steps.title: Open the VISU_MANCONTROL maintenance manual control screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the CELLIO STATUS navigation button.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI (VISU / WebVisu), open the maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed and includes the CELLIO STATUS button (Item 9).
steps.healthy_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL is visible with the CELLIO STATUS button present.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL is not displayed, or the CELLIO STATUS button is not present/accessible.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_MANCONTROL
actions.exact_action: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach VISU_MANCONTROL or cannot locate the CELLIO STATUS button, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Item 9 is the CELLIO STATUS button to open a screen containing the cell control input and output values per tipper.

steps.title: Press CELLIO STATUS to open the cell control I/O values screen per tipper
steps.purpose: Open the CELLIO STATUS sub-screen that displays cell control input/output values per tipper.
steps.instruction: On VISU_MANCONTROL, press the CELLIO STATUS button (Item 9).
steps.failure_condition: The CELLIO STATUS screen does not open.

actions.label: Open CELLIO STATUS sub-screen
actions.exact_action: Press the CELLIO STATUS button (Item 9) to open the cell control input/output values screen per tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the CELLIO STATUS screen fails to open, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 9: The CELLIO STATUS button to open a screen containing the cell control input and output values per tipper.

steps.title: Verify cell control input/output values are displayed for each tipper
steps.purpose: Confirm the CELLIO STATUS screen is populated with the expected cell control I/O values per tipper.
steps.instruction: On the CELLIO STATUS screen, verify that cell control input and output values are displayed for each tipper.
steps.expected_result: Cell control input and output values are displayed for each tipper on the CELLIO STATUS screen.
steps.healthy_condition: For each tipper, the CELLIO STATUS screen shows non-blank cell control input/output values.
steps.failure_condition: The CELLIO STATUS screen shows missing/blank input/output values for one or more tippers.

actions.label: Check displayed I/O values per tipper
actions.exact_action: On the CELLIO screen, verify that cell control input and output values are displayed for each tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the expected input/output values are missing/blank, stop and escalate.

healthy_conditions: CELLIO STATUS screen is open and populated with cell control input/output values per tipper.
failure_conditions: CELLIO STATUS screen does not open.
Cell control input/output values are missing or blank for one or more tippers.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the CELLIO STATUS screen fails to open or if the expected input/output values are missing/blank.
